description: S3 family > 3-card roster > strategy branch > full setup variant > occurrence

normalization_rules.family: manually grounded source label or 3-card roster pattern; manual families may contain multiple lineups
normalization_rules.roster: three normalized card names sorted, preserving YanYi (연의) and SP card distinctions
normalization_rules.setup: formation, per-position text of strategy/warbooks/branch/gear/horse/stats; no semantic skill equivalence assumed
normalization_rules.occurrence: one original source-table item, independent of repeated setups and squads
never_merge: 연의 원소 ≠ 원소 unless explicitly verified

normalization_rules.qualifiers: 궁병/창병/기병/방패병 and suffix class not a new character, preserved as variant property
normalization_rules.strategy_branch: Same formation and first alternative for each general’s two abilities irrespective of ability slot order; approximation for navigation only. Full setups and options remain separate.

notes:
안형 공성 북벌창과는 반반, 다른 북벌창 상대로는 우세, 반격덱이나 각종 악질덱 상대로는 매우 강함.
다만 여러 속공덱에는 카운터를 맞지만, 그래도 운이 좋으면 이길 가능성은 있음.
